imagery.method: Reviewed independent Leaflet satellite captures for all 36 active sites; measured scale is approximately 0.21597969983351006 m/pixel. Building, parking/apron and visible access extents are estimates from imagery.

limits: No official parcel or building-footprint polygons were used.
Dimensions, area centers and spawns are imagery/road-geometry estimates, not surveyed measurements.
Imagery does not independently verify apparatus doors, gates, access controls, current pavement, or current building occupancy.
Canonical station source coordinates and IDs remain unchanged.

Continuous-exit QA follows an actual city route from each spawn until at least 10 m beyond the fitted yard, then resolves movement in 1.5 m steps; it verifies the modeled collision transition but not a sustained manual drive or real-world dispatch suitability.

runtimeCollisionChecks.method: Browser QA started PTBO_ROAD_COLLISION.beginStationExit, selected a real route call from each base until the route left a 10 m expanded driving-area boundary, then moved along that route in 1.5 m steps with resolveMovement. Each path had to leave the expanded yard on a drivable point with no blocked moves.
